bibl.title: Rubric Confusion in SM 96A.24-47: A Fragment of Erotylos' Orphica or a Recipe for a Rotulus Amulet?
bibl.seg: Christopher A. Faraone, Rubric Confusion in SM 96A.24-47: A Fragment of Erotylos' Orphica or a Recipe for a Rotulus Amulet?
bibl.note: P. Mil. Vogl. Inv. 1245 (= P. Cazzaniga Mag. 1; Suppl. Mag. II, 96A), 24-47. The rubric ηρυτυλος at line 24 introduces a long narrow list of words and it is usually interpreted as Ἐρωτύλος, the name of an author, but it might be the Latin term rotulus transliterated imperfectly into Greek ῥυτυλος.
